description: Dollar General Corporation is the largest discount retailer in the United States by number of stores, with 20,959 stores located in 48 U.S. states and Mexico as of February 27, 2026, with the greatest concentration of stores in the southern, southwestern, midwestern and eastern United States, and its first stores in Mexico opened in 2023. It offers a broad selection of merchandise, including consumable items, seasonal items, home products and apparel, including national brands from leading manufacturers as well as its own private brand selections with prices at substantial discounts to national brands, offered to customers at everyday low prices, typically $10 or less, in its convenient small-box locations, and its history began when J.L. Turner founded the company in 1939 as J.L. Turner and Son, Wholesale, incorporated as a Kentucky corporation under the name J.L. Turner & Son, Inc. in 1955 when it opened its first Dollar General store.
